summary: Midera Food Processing, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its Form 10 for the spin-off from The Middleby Corporation became effective June 17, 2026. The distribution will occur on July 6, 2026, with Middleby shareholders receiving one Midera share for each Middleby share held on the June 26 record date. Midera common stock will trade when-issued under MFPVV starting June 26 and regular way under MFP on July 7. The spin-off is subject to customary conditions. Key watch items: any conditions to close and post-spin trading performance.
